metadata.description: Claude Code skills for AI-native development: quality assurance, supply chain security, and architecture patterns

plugins.name: qa-check
plugins.description: Review code changes for AI Quality Paradox violations and AI-native architecture anti-patterns. Flags rework risk, missing test coverage, complexity concerns, and validation gaps. Based on Mennillo 2026 research.

plugins.name: supply-chain-check
plugins.description: Single-command supply chain security audit. Scans for compromised packages, dangerous version ranges, lock file issues, CVEs, typosquatting, and local IOC artifacts. Wraps npm audit with active threat heuristics.
